strings.string: All four palettes are included. Neon Cyan is a colour name; the MIP screen does not glow.

Original shows ASTROBYTE / INDUSTRIES. Choose Custom to use Custom first/second line, or Manual city to use City text and City subtitle. Hidden hides the identity plate. Text fields remain visible in settings; only the selected mode uses them.

Set Identity plate to Custom to show this line. Other modes ignore it and keep its saved text. Up to 64 characters. Displayed in uppercase; unsupported characters become ?. Long text is shortened on screen only.
Set Identity plate to Manual city to show this city label. Other modes ignore it and keep its saved text. Up to 64 characters. No GPS or automatic city lookup. Blank city uses the Original plate.

Set Identity plate to Manual city to show this subtitle beneath a nonblank city label. Other modes ignore it and keep its saved text. Up to 64 characters; blank is allowed. Uppercase ASCII is supported; long text is shortened on screen only.
Enlarge the bottom data values where space permits. Long values still fit within their slots.
Follow the watch preference, or choose 12 or 24 hours. Time always uses the watch local time, not Tokyo time.
Show 08 instead of 8 in the hour row. Minutes always use two digits.
Off by default. While active shows seconds only during the watch active state; seconds disappear in low power.
Units for Garmin cached outdoor weather, when available. This is not the watch temperature sensor.
Show or hide the decorative TERMINAL // AC-01 text at the bottom of the face.
